SUMMARY Results-driven Software Engineer with 10 years of experience designing, developing, and implementing scalable applications using a wide range of technologies and programming languages. Proven expertise in full-stack development, delivering end-to-end solutions across diverse domains. Eager to leverage broad technical knowledge and hands-on problem-solving skills in a challenging Full Stack Developer role. CONTACT 9304820702/9087756835 aznawaz90@gmail.com https://www.linkedin.com/in/asif-nawaz-56593120/ CORE COMPETENCIES Program/Project Documentation Preparation Regulatory and Compliance Awareness Agile Process Adherence CI/CD Pipeline Customization Release Management Stakeholder Coordination Production Support Ownership Domain Knowledge (Banking, Insurance, Telecom) Performance Monitoring and Load Testing Audit and Data Verification EDUCATION 2011-2014: Masters in computer application(MCA) Rajarajeswari College of Engineering Bangalore (VTU), 80% Asif Nawaz Technical Lead PROFILE SUMMARY Java & JVM Proficiency – Extensive hands-on experience with Java 6/7/8/11/17, including Java SE, concurrent programming, collections, and algorithmic design. Spring Ecosystem & Microservices – Deep expertise in Spring Framework/Spring Boot 3.x, including IOC, MVC, Security, REST controllers, GraphQL, and Spring Boot microservices patterns (CQRS, SAGA, Resilience4j, Rate Limiting, API Gateway, Netflix Eureka). Enterprise Frameworks & Persistence – Strong knowledge of JPA/Hibernate, Spring Data Access, and transaction management; experience with Hibernate ORM and complex SQL (MySQL, SQL Server, DB2). Asynchronous Messaging – Robust experience integrating Apache Kafka and RabbitMQ with Java/Spring for high-throughput, event-driven architectures. DevOps & Cloud Infrastructure – AWS Cloud deployment, Docker containerization, Kubernetes orchestration; CI/CD pipelines using Git, Jenkins; code quality tools like SonarQube, FindBugs, Structure101. Networking & Telecom Standards – Advanced domain knowledge in NMS/OTN, Router management (SNMP, Netconf), and Telecom monitoring frameworks. Design & Architecture – Skilled in MVC, RESTful API design, microservices, domain-driven architecture, UML modeling, and design patterns (Factory, Singleton, DAO, Business Delegate). Databases & Integration – Experience in relational databases and integration via JDBC, stored procedures, MongoDB; designing scalable schemas and optimizing DB performance. Agile & SDLC Practices – Full SDLC lifecycle experience in both Agile (Scrum) and traditional methodologies; strong emphasis on TDD, unit/integration testing. Programming Disciplines & Code Quality – Strong background in data structures, algorithms, clean code principles, code reviews, and static analysis. Python & Web Frameworks – Additional experience in Python and Django, enhancing full-stack versatility. IDE & Build Tools – Proficient in IntelliJ IDEA, Eclipse, VS Code; build automation with Maven and Gradle. DOMAIN EXPERTISE Banking & Insurance – Extensive exposure to financial processes, compliance, and transaction systems. Telecom & Networking – Hands-on experience with SNMP, NMS, OTN, and network element control using Java frameworks. Finance & Enterprise Systems – Developed high-availability, scalable enterprise applications for financial and corporate domains. WORK EXPERIENCE Technical Lead, Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) | April 2023 – Present Technical Lead, Nokia | May 2019 – April 2023 Senior Software Engineer, HCL Technologies | December 2017 – April 2019 Software Engineer, Global Analytics Pvt. Ltd. (GAIN Credit) | April 2015 – December 2017

PROJECTS

HPE Telco vTeMIP Access Module — Hewlett Packard Enterprise

Technologies: Java 17, Spring Boot 3.2, Microservices, REST APIs, Hibernate, Apache Kafka, SNMP4J, Salesforce, Jenkins, Git, SonarQube
Team Size: 10

Developed and maintained enterprise-grade, data-centric telecom management services using Java and Spring Boot.

Designed and implemented RESTful APIs consumed by various clients; utilized Swagger for endpoint simulation and testing.

Reduced system failure rates by 70% through robust unit and load testing.

Customized CI/CD pipelines via Jenkins for efficient build and deployment workflows.

Worked directly with clients to gather requirements and resolve technical dependencies.

TMS (Transportation Management Solution) — Nokia

Technologies: Java 11, Spring Boot, REST, Eureka, Microservices, MySQL, Docker, Kubernetes, Kafka, Jenkins, AWS
Team Size: 13

Built and customized fault and performance management modules using Spring Boot microservices for network health monitoring.

Developed SNMP Alarm Handler and simulated message flows using Kafka and REST APIs for end-to-end fault analysis.

Actively involved in full SDLC including requirements gathering, development, testing, and production support.

Automated deployments and environment configurations using Docker, Kubernetes, and Jenkins.

Created detailed technical documentation and participated in UAT and production rollouts.

CrossWorks Network Automation (NCA) — HCL Technologies

Technologies: Java 8, Spring Boot, J2EE, Netconf, NSO, YANG, YDK, Docker, Kubernetes, Python, Postgres, SQL Server
Team Size: 18

Developed automation solutions for router configuration management using Netconf and Cisco NSO within the CrossWorks framework.

Designed and implemented modular playbooks leveraging YANG/YDK for automated router tasks and configuration tracking.

Delivered complete backup and restore functionality for router configurations.

Built SQL queries and stored procedures to support backend data operations in PostgreSQL and SQL Server.

Contributed across all project phases—requirements, design, implementation, testing, and production support.

LendingStream 2.0 (Rebranding P&L) — Global Analytics – Banking & Insurance Domain

Technologies: Java, Spring Boot, Hibernate, MySQL, REST APIs, AWS
Team Size: 25

Led development of key card and payment modules in LendingStream 2.0, ensuring PCI DSS compliance and secure financial transactions.

Designed and deployed high-availability architecture using AWS EC2 and Elastic IPs for geo-failover support.

Implemented features such as eSign and SECCI pages to enhance customer loan onboarding experience.

Participated across the full SDLC in an Agile environment; recognized with promotion to Senior Software Engineer for outstanding contributions.

Line of Credit (LOC / LILOC) — Global Analytics – Insurance Domain

Technologies: Java, Spring Boot, Hibernate, MySQL, Python
Team Size: 9

Delivered new feature enhancements for a low-interest daily loan platform tailored to underbanked U.S. customers.

Designed and implemented core financial functionalities including Reclock and Charge-Off modules.

Supported financial audits by cleaning and stabilizing backend data using SQL and Python scripting.

Produced technical documentation during FD and TD phases, and provided production support to resolve real-time issues.
